mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 51 degrees and clear near Verona City Hall under a Waning Gibbous moon. Keep an eye on the sky at 5:05 AM tonight, as the space station will be visible from the northwest near Verona High School heading toward the northeast near Home Depot.

The city continues to manage engineering contracts with AECOM for various infrastructure projects. Additionally, the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking feedback on the US 18/151 corridor between Dodgeville and Fitchburg with meetings set for November 18 and 19.

We have a busy schedule today with live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, bring the family for Main Street trick-or-treating or stop by ART House 360 and Hop Haus for their weekly events.

In the weekly recap, officers reported that on Sunday, October 25, a 40-year-old man was arrested for an O W I offence after being found stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today at Culver's, enjoy the Chocolate Heath Crunch, which you can grab when the doors open today at 10:00 AM.
